rows.commentary: 0.1: Tharindu Ratnayake bowls a short‑wide delivery, turning sharply, and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi misses a cut.
0.2: Tharindu Ratnayake delivers another ball to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who fails to score.
0.3: Tharindu Ratnayake again bowls to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who attempts a reverse sweep but the ball grips and turns, missing the shot.
0.4: Tharindu Ratnayake's delivery clips the pads of Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and trickles toward square leg, allowing the pair to collect a single leg bye.
0.5: Tharindu Ratnayake bowls to Abhishek Sharma, who scores one run.
0.6: Tharindu Ratnayake to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, to deep extra cover
1.1: Abhishek Sharma lofts Sahan Arachchige with immense power to send the ball soaring over the long-off boundary for six.

1.2: Sahan Arachchige to Abhishek Sharma, out Caught by Sineth Jayawardena!! Sahan Arachchige gets his revenge on the very next delivery. Slows it up a touch and pulls his length back. Abhishek tries to make room and loft it over the off side, but gets a thick outside edge that flies straight into the hands of the fielder at short third, who makes no mistake. Not the surface where you can hit through the line whenever you want. Abhishek Sharma c Sineth Jayawardena b Sahan Arachchige 7(3) [6s-1]
1.3: Sahan Arachchige to Sanju Samson, no run, angling across from round the wicket, Sanju Samson punches it to cover
1.4: Sahan Arachchige to Sanju Samson, 1 run, turns in from the length close to off and Sanju Samson waits for it to arrive and then tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single

1.5: Sahan Arachchige to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, shot! Sahan Arachchige fires it short and wide and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi slashes it past cover point and point for a boundary. Rocks back and then slaps it with full control

1.6: Sahan Arachchige to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, a bit too high, I guess! Drifts in from round the wicket and Vaibhav misses as he tries to work it to the leg side, getting struck high on the pads

2.1: Tharindu Ratnayake to Sanju Samson, no run, here comes the ambidextrousness! Bowled off-spin to the left-handers in the first over and now switches to left-arm spin. Fires it in on the leg side as Sanju makes room to open up the off side, but makes no connection and is brushed on the pads.
2.2: Tharindu Ratnayake delivers a no ball to Sanju Samson as the umpire signals the illegal delivery.
2.2: Sanju Samson directs
2.3: Sanju Samson punishes Tharindu Ratnayake, carving the ball square of the wicket for a resounding four.
2.4: Tharindu Ratnayake delivers a tight ball to Sanju Samson, who evades it for a dot.
2.5: Tharindu Ratnayake again bowls to Sanju Samson, who leaves it for a dot.
2.6: Tharindu Ratnayake bowls to Sanju Samson, who backs away to play it off the off‑side, but the ball skids on, clips his pads and crashes into the stumps, giving Ratnayake his second wicket.
3.1: Binura Fernando delivers a slanted ball over the wicket, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi nudges it to the pads and wrists it to long‑on for a single.
3.2: Binura Fernando sends a quick ball to Shreyas Iyer, who nudges it to third man for a single.

3.3: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, on the fuller side this time around, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi swings across the line and gets it off the lower part as the ball goes to deep mid-wicket
3.4: Binura Fernando to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, seems like a cutter on short of a length, Shreyas Iyer waits for it and dabs it to point for a single

3.5: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, that’s a Vaibhav Sooryavanshi special! Not a bad ball - short of a length on this pitch, where you can’t flat-bat it down the ground. But the youngster does exactly that and gets enough on it to clear mid-off for a boundary

3.6: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, two in a row for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi! This one if a low full toss outside off and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi times the drive between mid-off and cover for another four
4.1: Tharindu Ratnayake to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, comes forward and eases this tossed up delivery to long-off for a single

4.2: Tharindu Ratnayake to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, drifting into the pads from round the wicket, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi goes down on one knee for the slog sweep but fails to make any contact and is struck on the pads
4.3: Tharindu Ratnayake delivers to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, a crisp line that floats to off stump and thumps short third on one bounce.
4.4: Tharindu Ratnayake unleashes a thunderbolt to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, sending it straight to third man for a four.
4.5: Tharindu Ratnayake to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, SIX, to deep mid-wicket.
4.6: Tharindu Ratnayake to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, to deep extra cover.
5.1: Binura Fernando to Shreyas Iyer, no run, off-cutter angling across from short of a length, Shreyas Iyer dabs it to the fielder at short third
5.2: Binura Fernando to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, it's on the same length but leg-lined, allowing Shreyas Iyer to work it to square leg for a single
5.3: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, slow and stays low as the ball slants into the pads, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
5.4: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run
5.5: Binura Fernando to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, SIX, to deep mid-wicket
5.6: Binura Fernando delivers a fullish ball around off, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi attempts a slog but misses to mid-on, no run, giving India a solid powerplay through his effort.
6.1: Sahan Arachchige to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, flatter close to off, Iyer goes back and knocks it to the right of the bowler for a single
6.2: Sahan Arachchige unleashes a sharp off‑spin to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who smacks a thick edge that sails to short‑third for a brilliant catch by Sineth Jayawardena.
6.3: Sahan Arachchige bowls a tight line to Ishan Kishan, who fails to score any runs.
6.4: Sahan Arachchige to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, drifts in once again and Ishan Kishan flicks it to wide long‑on to open his account
6.5: Sahan Arachchige to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, a tad on the shorter side and there is no pace on offer, Shreyas Iyer moves back and knocks it to long‑on without any fuss
6.6: Sahan Arachchige to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, gives it some air outside off and Ishan Kishan reaches out to smash it along the ground to sweeper cover for a single
7.1: Wanuja Sahan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, bwls it quicker and flatter on the pads, gets some grip as well, as Kishan chips it in the air towards mid-wicket for a single
7.2: Wanuja Sahan to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run
7.3: Wanuja Sahan bowls to Ishan Kishan, who nudges a single to long‑off.
7.4: Wanuja Sahan to Shreyas Iyer, a dead‑ball that yields no runs.
7.5: Wanuja Sahan to Shreyas Iyer, who drives a single to long‑off.
7.6: Wanuja Sahan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, fires it slightly fuller, Ishan Kishan
8.1: V Viyaskanth to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short and wide, Ishan Kishan moves away and slaps it past cover for a single
8.2: V Viyaskanth to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, to deep mid-wicket
8.3: V Viyaskanth delivers to Ishan Kishan, who launches a half‑volley outside off into the air and smashes it over the bowler’s head for a six.
8.4: V Viyaskanth bowls to Ishan Kishan, who plays a dead ball for no run.
8.5: V Viyaskanth bowls to Ishan Kishan, who fails to hit for a run.
8.6: Viyaskanth bowls to Ishan Kishan, a single skids to mid‑wicket.
9.1: Wanuja Sahan launches a powerful slog‑sweep to deep mid‑wicket, a soaring SIX that exits the park on the toss‑up delivery.
9.2: Wanuja Sahan nudges a single to long‑off, the batsman rotates the strike to the other end.
9.3: Wanuja Sahan fires a FOUR to Shreyas Iyer, a clean shot that rings across the boundary.
9.4: Shreyas Iyer is bowled by Wanuja Sahan, ending his 13‑run innings.
9.5: Wanuja Sahan to Axar Patel, no run, tossed up around off and Axar Patel reaches out and pushes it back to the bowler
9.6: Wanuja Sahan to Axar Patel, 1 run, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and turns this length delivery to deep mid-wicket for an easy single
10.1: V Viyaskanth to Axar Patel, no run
10.1: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Axar Patel, no run as the ball flares outside off and Axar lashes it to cover.
10.2: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Axar Patel, no run.
10.3: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Axar Patel, a single as the ball drifts wide and Axar sends it to sweeper cover.
10.4: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Ishan Kishan, a single to long‑off.
10.5: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Axar Patel, a single to long‑off.
10.6: Sahan Arachchige bowls to Ishan Kishan, who cuts a single to point to keep the strike.
11.1: Croospulle delivers a wide to Ishan Kishan.
11.1: Croospulle bowls a wide that drifts down the leg side, but Ishan Kishan misses it entirely and the umpire calls it a wide.
11.1: Croospulle delivers a short ball to Ishan Kishan, who swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
11.2: Croospulle bowls a short delivery to Axar Patel, who eases it to long‑off for a single.
11.3: Croospulle bowls to Ishan Kishan, who takes a single.
11.4: Croospulle bowls to Axar Patel, who runs a single to backward square leg.
11.5: Croospulle bowls to Ishan Kishan, who takes a single to long‑on.
11.6: Croospulle delivers to Axar Patel, no run
12.1: Sahan Arachchige to Ishan Kishan, 1 run
12.2: Sahan Arachchige to Axar Patel, 1 run, a tad on the shorter side, Axar Patel flat bats it to wide long‑on
12.3: Sahan Arachchige to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, to long‑off
12.4: Sahan Arachchige to Axar Patel, 1 run, to long‑off
12.5: Sahan Arachchige delivers a powerful drive to Ishan Kishan, sending the ball racing to third man for a FOUR.
12.6: Sahan Arachchige bowls again, Ishan Kishan nudges a single to backward point.
13.1: Croospulle to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, dragged short and at the pads, whipped behind square on the on-side for a single
13.2: Croospulle to Axar Patel, 1 run, to long-off
13.3: Croospulle to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, pushed through with a round‑arm action as Kishan came down the pitch, nudged with soft hands towards long‑on and they’re back for the second.
13.4: Croospulle bowls a flatter, quicker delivery to Ishan Kishan, who pulls it through mid‑wicket for a single.
13.5: Croospulle to Axar Patel, out Caught by Sahan Arachchige!!
13.6: Croospulle delivers to Tilak Varma, who nudges it to deep extra cover for a tidy two.
14.1: Nuwanidu Fernando to Ishan Kishan, SIX, clubbed, tad too full and it's right in the slot - Kishan leans forward and hoists it high over long‑on for a maximum
14.2: Nuwanidu Fernando to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, to deep square leg
14.3: Nuwanidu Fernando's delivery sails outside off, glides to long‑on for a single to Ishan Kishan.
14.4: Fernando tosses up, drifting into Tilak Varma; a soft leading edge as Tilak attempts to tuck it onto the on‑side, but no run.
14.5: Tilak Varma plays a reverse sweep, reads the bounce, yet cannot beat the backward point for a dot.
14.6: Nuwanidu Fernando delivers a sharp stumping, catching Tilak Varma off Sohan de Livera's off‑swing for a tidy 2‑run wicket.
15.1: Croospulle delivers a tight ball to Ishan Kishan, who deftly deflects it with a subtle flick, leaving the wicket untouched.
15.2: Croospulle launches a flighted delivery to Ishan Kishan, who nudges it to long‑off for a single.
15.3: Croospulle bowls a flatter ball to Shivam Dube, who whips it down to long‑on for a single.
15.4: Croospulle's ball finds the stumps as Ishan Kishan fails to score.
15.5: Croospulle delivers a full toss to Ishan Kishan, who misjudges the slog and misfires it toward mid‑wicket, conceding a single.
15.6: Croospulle bowls to Shivam Dube, who fails to score.

16.1: Nuwanidu Fernando to Ishan Kishan, SIX, slapped, flighted delivery around off - Ishan Kishan comes down the pitch, makes room on the inside out drive and then gets enough elevation to clear the fielder at long-off

16.2: Nuwanidu Fernando to Ishan Kishan, no run, how do you play this? Must've hit one of those cracks - pitchd on middle and then it ripped well past Kishan - Sohan de Livera has to move to his right to collect the ball
16.3: Nuwanidu Fernando to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, to long-off
16.4: Nuwanidu Fernando to Shivam Dube, 1 run, to short mid-wicket
16.5: Nuwanidu Fernando bowls a precise delivery to Ishan Kishan, who nudges it to mid‑wicket for a single.
16.6: Nuwanidu Fernando bowls to Shivam Dube, who fails to score.
17.1: Croospulle launches a flighted delivery to Ishan Kishan, who drags it down the off-side to long‑on for a crisp single.
17.2: Croospulle bowls a tossed‑up ball to Shivam Dube, who guides it down the middle to long‑on for a tidy single.
17.3: Croospulle unleashes a blistering drive to Ishan Kishan, who smashes it to long‑on for a thunderous four.
17.4: Croospulle to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, to deep mid-wicket.

17.5: Croospulle to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, Ishan Kishan gets lucky once again – aiming to loft it over the bowler’s head, he overshot and the ball lobbled up, falling neatly between the bowler and the cover fielder.
17.6: Croospulle to Shivam Dube, no run, flighted delivery outside off – Dube backs away and steers it to backward point.

18.1: Tharindu Ratnayake to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, nicely played, Ishan Kishan is playing a blinder here - bends down low, reverses the stance and gets enough on the reverse sweep to clear short third, one bounce and over the ropes
18.2: Tharindu Ratnayake to Ishan Kishan, 1 run
18.3: Tharindu Ratnayake to Shivam Dube, no run

18.4: Tharindu Ratnayake to Shivam Dube, no run, Dube is struggling to get going here - pushed through quicker as Dube came down the pitch - he swings and misses, deflects off the thigh-pad and Sohan de Livera can't collect it cleanly

18.5: Tharindu Ratnayake to Shivam Dube, out Caught by Sahan Arachchige!! That's a corker at cover and it's the Sri Lankan captain who has come up with an absolute blinder of a catch. Shivam Dube c Sahan Arachchige b Tharindu Ratnayake 3(9)
18.6: Tharindu Ratnayake bowls to Washington Sundar, no run.
19.1: Binura Fernando to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, to long‑on.
19.2: Binura Fernando to Ishan Kishan, SIX, to deep mid-wicket
19.3: Binura Fernando delivers a wide to Ishan Kishan.
19.3: Binura Fernando delivers a slower ball to Ishan Kishan, who drives it down to long‑off for a single.
19.4: Binura Fernando unleashes a thunderbolt to Washington Sundar, who smashes it to deep mid‑wicket for a six.
19.5: Binura Fernando to Washington Sundar, 1 run, to extra cover
19.6: Binura Fernando to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, to long-off
0.1: Jasprit Bumrah delivers a good length ball to Sineth Jayawardena, who defends just behind the line, no run.
0.2: Jasprit Bumrah bowls a lethal lbw, Sineth Jayawardena is out, 0(2).
0.3: Jasprit Bumrah to Sohan de Livera, no run.
0.4: Jasprit Bumrah to Sohan de Livera, no run, shortens the length and pushes one across the left-hander, has Livera sparring and beats him on the outside edge.
0.5: Jasprit Bumrah to Sohan de Livera, out caught by Sanju Samson, edged and caught!
0.6: Jasprit Bumrah digs it in short and angles it back, forcing Nuwanidu Fernando to skew a thick inside edge behind square on the on-side for a single.
1.1: Axar Patel floats it up and drifts it down leg, past Nuwanidu Fernando's sweep to signal a wide.

1.1: Axar Patel delivers to Nuwanidu Fernando, ending in a disastrous run out as Ravi Bishnoi swoops in with a lightning-fast one-handed direct hit to catch Lasith Croospulle short by yards for a diamond duck.
1.2: Axar Patel tosses one up outside off, cleanly steered off the back-foot toward backward point by Sahan Arachchige.
1.3: Axar Patel is dispatched square of the wicket for four by Sahan Arachchige.
1.4: Axar Patel beats the bat as Sahan Arachchige collects four leg byes.
1.5: Axar Patel darts it through on middle and leg, Sahan Arachchige attempts the sweep, gets an under-edge onto his thigh-pad, and watches it trickle away before a sliding fielder cuts it off.
1.6: Axar Patel keeps it tight, beating Nuwanidu Fernando completely.
2.1: Jasprit Bumrah drops it on a good length around off, easily dead-batted right back to the bowler by Sahan Arachchige.
2.2: Jasprit Bumrah strays just enough, and Sahan Arachchige guides it expertly down to square third man for four.
2.3: Jasprit Bumrah beats the bat, scampering a bye as the ball races past the keeper.
2.4: Jasprit Bumrah lands it on a length at the stumps, and Nuwanidu Fernando marches down the pitch to turn it past square leg, racing back for a comfortable second run.
2.5: Jasprit Bumrah hunts for early rhythm, finding Nuwanidu Fernando ready to leave that one alone.
2.6: Jasprit Bumrah tests the batter with a delivery short of a length and at the stumps, clipped off the back-foot straight to square leg.
3.1: Axar Patel strikes as Sahan Arachchige holes out to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, leaving Sri Lanka deep in trouble at 9.
3.2: Axar Patel tosses one up sliding into the right-hander, beating Ashen's flick as it drops dead at his feet.
3.3: Axar Patel offers flight on off, and Ashen Bandara pushes it straight back at the bowler.
3.4: Axar Patel claims another as Ashen Bandara falls caught by Washington Sundar for a duck.
3.5: Axar Patel darts one in tightly, and Chamika Karunaratne defends solidly to keep it out.
3.6: Axar Patel keeps it on the spot, and Chamika Karunaratne stays back to block another dot.
4.1: Washington Sundar drifts this one well wide of the off-stump, forcing the umpire to stretch his arms and signal the extra.
4.1: Washington Sundar tosses it up, and Nuwanidu Fernando dispatches it into the deep square leg stands for a maximum.
4.2: Washington Sundar serves a flighted delivery outside off, and Nuwanidu Fernando simply pushes it straight back at the bowler.
4.3: Washington Sundar floats it up nicely, and Nuwanidu Fernando shuffles across to launch a monstrous slog-sweep sailing high over wide mid-wicket for another maximum.
4.4: Washington Sundar fires it flatter and quicker on off, catching Nuwanidu Fernando looking to stab as the ball beats the bat.
4.5: Disaster for Sri Lanka as a mix-up leaves Nuwanidu Fernando short, run out for 15 by the combination of Axar Patel and Sanju Samson.
4.6: Washington Sundar comes from round the wicket with some flight, and Wanuja Sahan pushes half-forward to defend it safely to the off-side.
5.1: Axar Patel fires a slider onto the stumps, and Chamika Karunaratne gets an inside edge off his defense that rolls away behind square for a single.
5.2: Axar Patel delivers, and Wanuja Sahan blocks it out solidly.
5.3: Axar Patel floats it right on the stumps as Wanuja Sahan defends securely from the crease.
5.4: Axar Patel beats Wanuja Sahan on the sweep, the ball looping off the pad to land safely just short of slip.
5.5: Axar Patel fires it flatter into the stumps, forcing Wanuja Sahan back to defend.
5.6: Axar Patel serves up a full delivery, promptly worked away by Wanuja Sahan through backward square leg for a single.
6.1: Washington Sundar rounds the wicket and extracts startling turn outside off, beating everyone including Sanju before deflecting off the glove to first slip.
6.2: Washington Sundar strikes as Wanuja Sahan attempts a reverse sweep, getting extra bounce that catches the glove for Abhishek Sharma to comfortably take at first slip.
6.3: Washington Sundar targets the stumps with a slider, met with a firm defensive stroke from the crease by Tharindu Ratnayake.
6.4: Washington Sundar floats one invitingly outside off stump, leaving Tharindu Ratnayake swinging and missing at the drive.
6.5: Washington Sundar delivers a flatter trajectory, initial misjudgment corrected just in time as Tharindu Ratnayake defends from the crease.
6.6: Washington Sundar bowls a tight dot ball to conclude the over against Tharindu Ratnayake.
7.1: Ravi Bishnoi fires it viciously down the leg-side, eluding Sanju entirely to yield a couple of wides.
7.1: Ravi Bishnoi appeals in vain as the ball pitches outside leg, allowing Tharindu Ratnayake to scamper through for a leg bye down to third man.
7.2: Ravi Bishnoi errs in line, spraying a wide down the leg-side to Chamika Karunaratne.
7.2: Ravi Bishnoi drops it short, and Chamika Karunaratne pulls it away cleanly to collect a single at mid-wicket.
7.3: Ravi Bishnoi fires a low-bouncing googly outside off, leaving Tharindu Ratnayake playing inside the line and beating the bat.
7.4: Ravi Bishnoi hurries Tharindu Ratnayake with a quicker short delivery outside off that flashes past the attempted cut.
7.5: Ravi Bishnoi keeps the pressure ratcheted up on Tharindu Ratnayake with another dot ball.
7.6: Ravi Bishnoi delivers it flat, and Tharindu Ratnayake stays back to defend securely.
8.1: Washington Sundar extracts extra bounce from a good length on a flatter trajectory, allowing Chamika Karunaratne to knock it right of the bowler and scamper through for a single.
8.2: Washington Sundar arrows in a very full delivery, clipped neatly away to mid-wicket.
8.3: Washington Sundar angles it in from round the wicket to thud the pad, but the appeal is immediately muted as it drifts harmlessly down the leg-side.
8.4: Washington Sundar watches Tharindu Ratnayake swing wildly across the line in search of a massive blow, only to find complete air.
8.5: Washington Sundar targets outside the off stump with a flatter delivery, and Tharindu Ratnayake dead-bats it into the off-side.
8.6: Washington Sundar offers width, and Tharindu Ratnayake drills it crisply away to the deep extra cover boundary for four.
9.1: Abhishek Sharma tosses it up outside off stump, and Chamika Karunaratne pushes it toward cover to complete a single.
9.2: Abhishek Sharma extracts a slog from Tharindu Ratnayake, who drags it off the inside half of the bat down to backward square leg for one.
9.3: Abhishek Sharma bowls to Chamika Karunaratne, and Tharindu Ratnayake is run out by Tilak Varma for 5 runs off 15 balls, including one four.
9.4: Abhishek Sharma outsmarts Chamika Karunaratne with prodigious turn, drawing the batsman out of his crease before Sanju Samson clinically whips off the bails to complete a sharp stumping.
9.5: Abhishek Sharma slips a decisive slider right through Binura Fernando's defenses to crash into the leg stump, sending India roaring into the Gold Medal match.

preview.text: India play Sri Lanka at Korogi Sports Park. In 32 recorded T20 meetings, India have won 21 and Sri Lanka 9. Sides batting first here usually make about 145 (6 recorded T20 matches). Sri Lanka won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 0 per cent chance of rain, at about 27 degrees.

summary.text: India won by 124 runs. IND made 169-7, Ishan Kishan top-scoring with 80 off 46 balls; Sahan Arachchige (c) took 2 for 28. SL made 45-10, Nuwanidu Fernando top-scoring with 15 off 11 balls; Abhishek Sharma took 2 for 2. Sides batting first at Korogi Sports Park usually make about 145.
